page_title: STR 3-1 LYO | Strasbourg v Lyon 22/02/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+9' Gary O'Neil is forced to make a change. Samuel Amo-Ameyaw is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Gessime Yassine (Strasbourg).
90+5' Samuel Amo-Ameyaw (Strasbourg) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.

90+5' Nicolas Tagliafico (Lyon) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Ruddy Buquet with no other option than to blow for a foul.
90' 8 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Gary O'Neil has decided to substitute Andrew Omobamidele and he is replaced by Aaron Anselmino (Strasbourg).
90' The game has come to an end for Diego Moreira. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Samuel Amo-Ameyaw (Strasbourg).
88' Clinton Mata (Lyon) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.

88' Joaquin Panichelli (Strasbourg) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle. Lyon are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
85' That's the end of the game for Ruben Kluivert, who is replaced by Nicolas Tagliafico (Lyon).
85' Here is a change. Julio Enciso is going off and Gary O'Neil gives the last tactical orders to Abdoul Ouattara (Strasbourg).
83' 3 - 1 Goal! Joaquin Panichelli (Strasbourg) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Dominik Greif into the bottom right corner.
83' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Corentin Tolisso as he is replaced by Remi Himbert (Lyon).
83' Joaquin Panichelli (Strasbourg) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
82' The Strasbourg players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!
80' Referee Ruddy Buquet makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Strasbourg. Let’s see what happens!
79' PENALTY APPEAL after Samir El Mourabet (Strasbourg) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
77' Neat passing move from Lyon in order to create new attacking opportunities.
74' Ruben Kluivert (Lyon) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Strasbourg have a free kick.
72' Ruddy Buquet interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Ainsley Maitland-Niles (Lyon). Strasbourg have been awarded a free kick.
70' Endrick (Lyon) picks up a short pass and immediately fires a shot towards the middle of the goal from distance, but Mike Penders hardly has to move and makes a very easy save.
66' The linesman signals that Roman Yaremchuk (Lyon) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
64' Joaquin Panichelli (Strasbourg) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Ruddy Buquet blows his whistle for a foul. Lyon earn a free kick.
60+5' Nicolas Tagliafico (Lyon) makes a strong challenge and Ruddy Buquet blows for a foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to Strasbourg.
60' Endrick (Lyon) is shown a yellow card by the referee for dissent.

59' 2 - 1 It's a goal! Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) shows off his superb ability as he volleys the ball from inside the box into the left side of the target. The assist goes to Roman Yaremchuk and the score changes to 2:1.
58' Roman Yaremchuk (Lyon) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Tanner Tessmann.
57' Andrew Omobamidele (Strasbourg) infringed the rules and goes into the book. Ruddy Buquet pulls out a yellow card.
57' Ruddy Buquet has issued a yellow card to Ruben Kluivert (Lyon).
54' Paulo Fonseca (Lyon) gets a yellow card, off the field.
52' 2 - 0 Goal! Diego Moreira (Strasbourg) collected a pass and decided to try his luck from distance. The shot was deflected and it was enough to turn the ball past helpless Dominik Greif. 2:0.
51' Strasbourg quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

51' Diego Moreira (Strasbourg) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range towards the top left corner, but Dominik Greif is equal to it and makes an easy save. The linesman points to the corner flag, Strasbourg are going to take it.
50' Guela Doue (Strasbourg) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul. Lyon are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
46' Ruddy Buquet couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Clinton Mata (Lyon) and blew his whistle. Strasbourg win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
46' Ruddy Buquet blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+6' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+5' The corner is swung in but Lyon can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
45' We will have 5 min. of added time.
45' Flag up against Endrick (Lyon). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
45' Joaquin Panichelli (Strasbourg) was too forceful with his tackle and Ruddy Buquet interrupted the game to signal a free kick. A free kick has been awarded to Lyon.
41' Martial Godo (Strasbourg) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
37' 1 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Diego Moreira plays it into the box, and Martial Godo (Strasbourg) gets on the end of the cross to put it into the bottom right corner. 1:0.
33' The resulting set piece from Strasbourg is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
33' Martial Godo (Strasbourg) picks up a precise pass deep inside the box, but his strike is saved by the keeper. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Strasbourg.
32' Lyon failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
30' Ruddy Buquet blows for a foul after Julio Enciso (Strasbourg) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. It's a free kick to Lyon in a dangerous position.
28' Paulo Fonseca is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Pavel Sulc suffers an injury and Noah Nartey (Lyon) comes on.
25' Pavel Sulc (Lyon) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.

24' What a save from Dominik Greif! Joaquin Panichelli (Strasbourg) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant stop to keep it out.
22' Valentin Barco (Strasbourg) tackles a bit over-zealously and Ruddy Buquet blows for a foul. A free kick to Lyon.
19' Valentin Barco (Strasbourg) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.

18' Tanner Tessmann (Lyon) beautifully controls a cross from the wing inside the box, but he fails to test the keeper and sends his shot miles over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Strasbourg.
16' Ruddy Buquet has a clear sight and sees a foul from Samir El Mourabet (Strasbourg). Lyon get a free kick.
14' Julio Enciso (Strasbourg) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
14' Pavel Sulc (Lyon) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
13' Julio Enciso (Strasbourg) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
13' The game is interrupted now, Pavel Sulc (Lyon) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
12' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Strasbourg comes to nothing.
11' The corner is bent into the box and met with a firm header by Joaquin Panichelli (Strasbourg), but it's just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lyon.
11' Strasbourg will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
6' Martial Godo (Strasbourg) stretches for the rebound inside the box, but can only send it high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Lyon will have a goal kick.

6' Joaquin Panichelli (Strasbourg) receives a precise pass inside the box and drills a promising first-time blast towards the middle of the goal. His effort is blocked by Dominik Greif who dives to keep the ball out. What a save!
6' Lyon control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
2' Abner Vinicius (Lyon) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Lyon will kick-off.
Ruddy Buquet will referee today's match.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
